sample_unit: queries (1,034 symptom queries plus 487 dietary-safety queries)

links.outcome: Diagnosis retrieval accuracy with vs without acquiring missing patient context before answering
links.effect: Framework increased exact Top-1 accuracy by at least 57.1 percentage points and selective exact Recall@5 by at least 77.7 points across five models versus direct prompting.
links.quote: In diagnosis retrieval, it increased overall exact Top-1 accuracy by at least 57.1 percentage points and selective exact Recall@5 by at least 77.7 percentage points across the five evaluated models compared with direct prompting.

unlisted_practices: Knowledge-graph-guided agentic clarification framework asking targeted follow-up questions to resolve patient-context ambiguity before LLM response generation

screen.practice: clarifying follow-up questions before LLM response (knowledge-graph-guided context acquisition)
screen.reason: Evaluates a modular agentic guardrail placed between patient queries and downstream LLMs that identifies ambiguity and queries for missing clinical context before answering.
